title: urvillea pterocarpa
intro: Urvillea pterocarpa, commonly known as "Gato Montes," is a plant species belonging to the Asteraceae family. This plant is known for its medicinal properties, which include providing health benefits such as anti-inflammatory and antioxidant effects, potentially aiding in the treatment of various health conditions. The therapeutic actions of Urvillea pterocarpa are attributed to its ability to modulate the immune system and exhibit antimicrobial properties. The bioactive constituents of Urvillea pterocarpa include sesquiterpenes, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties and health benefits.
